title: Transaction comment claims any failure rolls back, but invalid-sender clear errors are swallowed and committed
detail: clear_rejected_stamps logs a failed clear and returns Nil, so the pog.transaction commits anyway. A legacy invalid sender whose clear errors stays stamped-without-send, contradicting the comment's rollback guarantee (narrow: requires a legacy malformed row plus a clear-statement error).
recommended_fix: Either thread the clear through result.try inside the transaction so its error rolls both marks back, or soften the comment to state clear failures are logged and committed.

title: month_name added as third copy; existing helpers live in audit_report and evidence_humanize
detail: Third month_name helper in the codebase. The diff acknowledges the duplication in its own comment and defers consolidation, so this is documented rather than accidental, but the DRY norm (extract at 2+ repeats) is now triply breached.
recommended_fix: Consolidate to one shared helper (e.g. domain_helpers or a date format module) returning String, with thin adapters at the Option/Result call sites; track the already-noted follow-up.
